adjudication_summary: Worker-2/4/6 re-review closed the prior open ticket by recovering the XML Table 1 MIC matrix, reconciling linked database rows against primary locators, and preserving database-only/later-paper conflicts instead of converting them to source-verified claims.
summary: Coprisin paper is publication-grade with cautions: primary XML/PDF support five Table 1 peptide MIC rows and the mature defensin sequence context, while unsupported database claims about later activities, D-coprisin, dimeric CopA3, and variant-position notation are retained as conflicts.

materials_exhausted.note: OA packages contain XML/PDF/Figure 1/Figure 2 assets only; extraction_errors.jsonl records no supplementary assets found. No external supplement chase is needed for the resolved Table 1/database blockers.

per_layer_decision_rationale.layer_1_database: DBAASP assay/literature rows matching Table 1 and article metadata were source-verified; CAMP/dbAMP/APD6 rows with corrupted values, generic identities, later-paper claims, D-coprisin, dimeric CopA3, or CopA4 position-notation conflicts were preserved as source_conflict/database_only_no_primary_source.
per_layer_decision_rationale.layer_2_activity_toxicity: Primary XML Table 1 yields 10 MIC rows for CopN5 and CopA1-CopA4 against E. coli and S. aureus with μg/mL units and method locators; no toxicity/hemolysis rows are reported in this 2009 source.
per_layer_decision_rationale.layer_3_mechanism: The source supports defensin-like structure/activity context and immune induction, but no direct mechanism assay; later mechanism/toxicity/database claims are cautions, not primary findings for this paper.
per_layer_decision_rationale.material_packet: XML/PDF/OA package are present; archive and supplementary indexes show no supplementary assets. The prior table-shape blocker was an analysis extraction issue, not unrecoverable material.

caution_findings.evidence_context: APD6/CAMP/dbAMP rows include later-paper activity, D-coprisin, dimeric CopA3, hemolysis/cytotoxicity, antibiofilm, antifungal, anti-inflammatory, or wound-healing annotations that are not supported by local 2009 XML/PDF material.

Primary Table 1 sequence for CopA4 is LRCIALRKK-NH2, while source/database position labels differ as H24->R24 versus H23R; sequence and MIC values are preserved, but the notation conflict is not hidden.
Local primary source reports antibacterial MIC and expression/sequence context; toxicity and direct mechanism claims from databases/later papers are not promoted.
